requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with High Page Yield
requirements.Description: Develop new NGB keyed ink bottles with 6,000 page yield for black and 6,000 for CMY; CMY bottles must support sizes >8,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Supports high-volume printing and competitive positioning in SMB/Enterprise CISS segments.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires compatibility with NOA-F, IDS, PHA, and Magi/Nessie ink systems.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Bottles are available in required sizes, pass reliability and spill-free tests, and deliver specified yields in field tests.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Ensure new NGB bottles deliver spill-free reliability during user handling and refilling.
requirements.Rationale: Critical for customer satisfaction and reducing service incidents.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on bottle and NOA-F design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Field and lab tests confirm zero spills during normal use.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Implement NOA-F with a metal foiled labyrinth and lid label, maintaining compatibility with existing push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances reliability and security of ink delivery system.
requirements.Dependencies: Integration with existing hardware and bottle designs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F units pass all reliability and integration tests with new and legacy components.

requirements.Title: Reuse Superamp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie Ink
requirements.Description: Reuse Superamp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie ink without reformulation in the Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces R&D and validation costs, leverages proven components.
requirements.Dependencies: Ensures compatibility with new bottle and NOA-F systems.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: System passes all print quality, reliability, and regulatory tests with reused components.

requirements.Title: Ink Stability and IDS Characterization
requirements.Description: Model and validate ink stability, WVTR, air gain, flow rate, and IDS performance, including startup and NOA-F end-of-life scenarios.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures consistent print quality and long-term reliability.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on ink, IDS, and NOA-F design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All models and tests meet or exceed defined HP quality standards for stability and reliability.

requirements.Title: NOA-F as Service Parts for Warranty Support
requirements.Description: Provide NOA-F as service parts to support warranty obligations and field repairs.
requirements.Rationale: Improves serviceability and reduces downtime for customers.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires supply chain and part number integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F is available as a service part, with documented replacement procedure and inventory in place.

requirements.Title: Acumen 6 on Lid
requirements.Description: Implement Acumen 6 feature on the ink lid.
requirements.Rationale: Supports traceability and anti-counterfeit measures.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires lid design and Acumen 6 integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All lids include Acumen 6 and pass traceability validation.

requirements.Title: Factory Line Modifications for NOA-F and Ink Cart
requirements.Description: Modify SA14 factory line for NOA-F; add Magi ink cart and labeling tool in Orcus 5 line.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures manufacturing readiness for new components.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on final NOA-F, ink cart, and labeling tool specifications.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Factory lines are modified, validated, and achieve target production rates for new SKUs.

requirements.Title: Support Customer-Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Design PHA and NOA-F to be customer-replaceable for improved serviceability.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces service costs and downtime, enhances user experience.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires user documentation and design for easy replacement.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Users can replace PHA and NOA-F with standard tools and instructions; field tests confirm process is user-friendly.

requirements.Title: Warranty Page Life Goal of 80k Pages
requirements.Description: Design printer and key components to support a new warranty page life goal of 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Meets competitive and contractual requirements for durability.
requirements.Stakeholders: Product Management, Warranty Team, End Users
requirements.Dependencies: Requires robust design of paperpath, ink system, and service parts.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printers pass accelerated life tests for 80,000 pages under warranty conditions.

requirements.Title: SKU 2 (Hi + Hi PDL) PaaS Offering
requirements.Description: Develop SKU 2 with high and high PDL configurations for Printer-as-a-Service (PaaS) business model.
requirements.Rationale: Supports new business models and customer segments.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires configuration management and service integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SKU 2 is available for PaaS, with defined service and support packages.

requirements.Title: Reddington ID with Increased Tank Size
requirements.Description: Increase tank size for Reddington ID without changing Marconi-HI ADF; update input/output trays to align with tank protrusion.
requirements.Rationale: Supports higher ink capacity and page yield.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires mechanical design changes and tray integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Tank size increased, trays fit and function correctly, and printer passes fit/form/function tests.

requirements.Title: EPS Foam Packaging
requirements.Description: Use EPS foam for packaging to protect the printer during shipment.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces shipping damage and supports sustainability goals if recyclable.
requirements.Dependencies: Packaging design and supplier selection.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All shipments use EPS foam packaging, with damage rates below target threshold.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel Compliance
requirements.Description: Ensure product meets EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel (for PDL SKU) environmental requirements.
requirements.Rationale: Enables sales in regulated markets and supports HP sustainability goals.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires documentation, testing, and certification.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product is certified for EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel as applicable.

requirements.Title: Size Optimization and 4.3” CGD Display
requirements.Description: Optimize printer size and integrate a 4.3-inch CGD display.
requirements.Rationale: Improves usability and fits market requirements for compact, feature-rich printers.
requirements.Dependencies: Mechanical and electrical integration of display.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer meets size targets and display passes usability and reliability tests.

requirements.Title: New Tube Routing and Integration
requirements.Description: Leverage Sayan Sibstar tubes and implement new tube routing and integration for 4-tube platform.
requirements.Rationale: Supports increased ink flow and reliability for higher page yields.
requirements.Dependencies: Tube design, IDS, and carriage integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Tube routing supports target flow rates and reliability in system tests.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management
requirements.Description: Update service station aerosol management with spit platform changes due to tank modifications.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures clean operation and prevents contamination from increased ink handling.
requirements.Dependencies: Service station and tank design changes.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol management meets HP cleanliness and reliability standards in testing.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamic and Force Model Update
requirements.Description: Update carriage dynamic and force models to account for new tube routing and increased weights.
requirements.Rationale: Maintains print quality and reliability with new mechanical configuration.
requirements.Dependencies: Tube, carriage, and weight changes.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Carriage system passes dynamic and force validation tests.

requirements.Title: Paperpath Durability for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Enhance paperpath to support increased page life target of 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Critical to meet new warranty and reliability goals.
requirements.Dependencies: Material and design upgrades to paperpath components.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paperpath passes accelerated life testing for 80,000 pages.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance Serviceable Part (Post 80k Life)
requirements.Description: Design ink maintenance as a serviceable part for replacement after 80,000 pages by service centers.
requirements.Rationale: Supports extended product life and reduces total cost of ownership.
requirements.Dependencies: Service procedures and part availability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Service centers can replace ink maintenance part per documented procedure.

requirements.Title: 140ml K Bottles and New CMY Bottle Sizes
requirements.Description: Introduce new 140ml black (K) bottles and appropriately sized CMY bottles for Magellan.
requirements.Rationale: Supports higher page yield and new tank size.
requirements.Dependencies: Bottle design and supply chain readiness.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: New bottles are available, validated, and integrated into supply chain.

requirements.Title: New IDS Make-Break and FI Connection
requirements.Description: Develop new make-break and FI (fluid interface) connection for IDS, leveraging LEBI ink-tank with increased size, keying, and LOI, with one SHAID.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures reliable ink delivery and system security.
requirements.Dependencies: IDS and ink-tank design updates.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: System passes make-break, FI connection, and security validation tests.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Implement new IDS startup algorithm and air management system.
requirements.Rationale: Improves startup reliability and print quality.
requirements.Dependencies: IDS hardware and firmware updates.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Startup and air management meet defined success rates in system tests.

requirements.Title: New Servicing and Startup Algorithm
requirements.Description: Develop new servicing and startup algorithm for Magellan platform.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances reliability, minimizes ink waste, and improves customer experience.
requirements.Dependencies: Firmware and IDS integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Algorithm passes reliability and efficiency benchmarks in system tests.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality (PQ) Goals and Depletion Metrics
requirements.Description: Establish new print quality goals and depletion metrics to align with page yield definitions.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures consistent output and meets customer expectations for page yield.
requirements.Dependencies: Test method definition and validation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product meets or exceeds new PQ and depletion targets in field and lab tests.

requirements.Title: Reuse of Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU
requirements.Description: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, and Raccoon PSU in Magellan platform.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development time and leverages proven electronics.
requirements.Dependencies: Compatibility with new Magellan features and requirements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All reused components pass integration and reliability tests in Magellan.

requirements.Title: Stingray Wi-Fi Module and Dune FW Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate Stingray Wi-Fi module and Dune firmware (FW) into Magellan.
requirements.Rationale: Provides wireless connectivity and leverages existing firmware platform.
requirements.Dependencies: HW/FW compatibility and regulatory certification.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Wi-Fi and firmware pass all connectivity and functional tests in Magellan.

requirements.Title: Gauss4.xx Security (HW & FW)
requirements.Description: Implement Gauss4.xx hardware and firmware security features in Magellan.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures product security and compliance with HP security standards.
requirements.Dependencies: HW and FW integration with Magellan platform.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Security features pass HP security validation and external audit.

requirements.Title: Strategic Segment Protection and Growth
requirements.Description: Protect Micro/SMB segments, lead with LaserJet and flank with PDL in Medium/Enterprise, and grow CISS share in new segments.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns product with HP’s strategic business goals and market positioning.
requirements.Dependencies: Product features and market alignment.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product launches with targeted features for each segment and achieves growth KPIs.

requirements.Title: Support for Multiple Business Models and Solutions
requirements.Description: Support Consumer, SMB, and Enterprise business models, including PaaS, WorkFromHome/Flexworker, and onboarding via HPX, HP One, SMB Portal, and ECP paths.
requirements.Rationale: Expands addressable market and supports diverse customer needs.
requirements.Dependencies: Solution and service integration with platform.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product is compatible with all listed business models and onboarding paths.

requirements.Title: Scan Solution, SMB Manageability, and Enterprise Support
requirements.Description: Integrate scan solution, SMB manageability tools, and enterprise support (WJA, HPSM, JAM) into Magellan.
requirements.Rationale: Meets needs of business customers and supports managed print services.
requirements.Stakeholders: SMB/Enterprise Customers, Product Management, IT Admins
requirements.Dependencies: Software and solution integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product passes validation for all listed solutions and tools.

requirements.Title: Client and Driver Support
requirements.Description: Ensure compatibility with HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, and UFD clients and drivers.
requirements.Rationale: Enables broad deployment and ease of use in diverse IT environments.
requirements.Dependencies: Firmware and driver integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All listed clients and drivers are supported and pass compatibility tests.

requirements.Title: Schedule and SuperAmp PHA Life Constraint
requirements.Description: Schedule and SuperAmp PHA life at 65K are the least flexible constraints for Magellan.
requirements.Rationale: Critical path items for project delivery and product reliability.
requirements.Dependencies: Project planning and PHA design/life validation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Project milestones and PHA life targets are met as scheduled.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life of 2 Years and Throughput Targets
requirements.Description: Optimize for warranty life of 2 years and throughput of 25/20 ppm (PDL).
requirements.Rationale: Meets customer and competitive expectations for product performance.
requirements.Dependencies: Design, validation, and manufacturing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product passes 2-year warranty and throughput validation tests.

requirements.Title: Serviceability (Maintenance Box)
requirements.Description: Optimize for serviceability with a maintenance box solution.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces downtime and service costs for customers.
requirements.Dependencies: Maintenance box design and documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box is user or service-replaceable and passes serviceability tests.

requirements.Title: Host 12K-CMYK and Trade Page 6K Flexibility
requirements.Description: Allow flexibility in supporting host 12K-CMYK and trade page 6K yields as lower-priority/flexible requirements.
requirements.Rationale: Provides adaptability for future market or SKU changes.
requirements.Dependencies: Ink system and firmware flexibility.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: System can be configured for these yields if required.
